summary: queue.sendNowBehavior defaults to 'abort': "Send now" stops the running answer and sends the queued message at once, instead of moving it to the head of the queue.
howTo: Nothing to do if "Send now" should send now. To keep the old behaviour (send it once the running answer ends), set queue: { sendNowBehavior: 'next' } on AiChatProvider. Tests that call sendNow during a run with the default config now see stop() called. Editing a queued message also focuses the text field (Enter saves, Escape cancels) and returns the focus to Edit afterwards.
